title: Re-encoded reachable configuration
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite binary input, and let $s,u\in\mathbb{N}$. If $u$ is reachable at radius $s$, choose a sequence of choice bits witnessing that reachability and let the value be the configuration code, at radius $s+1$, of the configuration reached by running $N$ on $x$ with that sequence. If $u$ is not reachable at radius $s$, let the value be zero.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The supplied statement omits the reachability-witness equivalence and configuration-coding definitions; the chosen witness is the one selected by that equivalence.
